status: Separate removable carrier for the R2 fanout; installed drive and physical fit unverified
material: PETG or machined insulating plastic for a bench prototype; shrinkage, strength and creep unqualified
notes: The two original side-fastener axes locate the carrier on the fixed hard frame.
Two M2 screws and captive M2 nuts at the back edge retain the fanout. The PCB is removable to reach inner connector latches.

The front rail corners brace the carrier but do not have board posts. The corresponding unused PCB holes are removed in the current R2 placement. Earlier four-hole and four-post studies remain preserved.
Board bending, cable pull and connector loads need a physical retention test; support the removed PCB during mating.
M2 screw length and M3 engagement must be checked against actual nuts, washers and the installed frame before assembly.
This carrier is for the R2 hole positions. It does not replace or silently modify the published original fanout.
No housing, jaw-drive, cable, moving-tail or loaded-frame fit is inferred from static carrier checks.
